title: Add a health check endpoint

userStories.title: Create health check API route
userStories.description: Add a new GET /api/health endpoint that returns basic system health status including uptime, database connection, and service availability
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/health endpoint returns 200 OK when system is healthy
Response includes { status: 'ok', uptime: number, database: 'connected', timestamp: ISO8601 }
Endpoint responds within 100ms under normal conditions
Database connection check uses db.prepare('SELECT 1').get() to verify SQLite is responsive

userStories.title: Add OpenAPI documentation for health endpoint
userStories.description: Document the health check endpoint with JSDoc @swagger annotations so it appears in /api/docs Swagger UI
acceptanceCriteria: @swagger JSDoc comment includes GET /api/health with 200 response schema
Response schema documents all fields: status, uptime, database, timestamp with types
Health endpoint appears in Swagger UI at /api/docs with correct documentation
Example response included in OpenAPI spec

userStories.title: Add execution engine health checks
userStories.description: Extend health endpoint to report availability of claude, opencode, and codex binaries based on RORCA_AGENT setting
acceptanceCriteria: Health response includes executionEngine object with { agent: string, available: boolean, version?: string }
When RORCA_AGENT=claude, check CLAUDE_BIN path exists and is executable
When RORCA_AGENT=opencode, use opencode-detector.ts to check binary and version
When RORCA_AGENT=codex, use codex-detector.ts to check binary and version
Health check returns 200 even if execution engine is unavailable (degraded mode)

userStories.title: Add database migration status to health check
userStories.description: Report the current database schema version and whether all migrations have been applied successfully
acceptanceCriteria: Health response includes database object with { connected: boolean, migrationsApplied: number, latestMigration: string }
migrationsApplied count comes from querying applied_migrations table or migration tracking mechanism
latestMigration shows the filename of the most recent applied migration (e.g., '046_spec_generation_logs.sql')
If migrations table doesn't exist, report migrationsApplied: 0 and latestMigration: 'none'

userStories.title: Add active runs count to health check
userStories.description: Report the number of currently running pipeline runs to help diagnose load and queue depth
acceptanceCriteria: Health response includes activeRuns: number field
Query pipeline_runs table for COUNT(*) WHERE status='running'
If query fails, activeRuns is omitted rather than causing health check to fail
Response time remains under 100ms even with many active runs

userStories.title: Add health check unit tests
userStories.description: Write Jest tests for the health check endpoint covering success cases and degraded states
acceptanceCriteria: Test suite in backend/src/routes/__tests__/health.test.ts
Test case: health check returns 200 with all fields when system is healthy
Test case: health check returns 200 with database: 'disconnected' when DB unavailable
Test case: health check includes correct executionEngine data based on RORCA_AGENT env var
Tests mock database and binary detection to avoid filesystem dependencies
All tests pass with npm test

userStories.title: Add frontend health indicator
userStories.description: Display a small health status indicator in the frontend that periodically polls /api/health and shows system status
acceptanceCriteria: Health indicator component in src/components/HealthIndicator.tsx
Polls /api/health every 30 seconds using apiFetch
Shows green dot when status='ok', amber when executionEngine unavailable, red when database disconnected
Tooltip on hover shows full health details (uptime, active runs, DB status, execution engine)
Indicator appears in Shell component footer or status bar

suggestedSkills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
suggestedSkills.reason: Component optimization for periodic polling without causing unnecessary re-renders

userStories.title: Document health check endpoint in CLAUDE.md
userStories.description: Add health check endpoint documentation to the CLAUDE.md API Routes section with usage examples
acceptanceCriteria: New entry in API Routes table: GET /api/health | Health check with system status
Example response JSON showing all fields documented in the table
Note about 200 status code even in degraded states (never returns 5xx)
Usage example: curl http://localhost:3030/api/health | jq

=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
test: true

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
name: rorca
type: web-app
stack:
  - React 18
  - TypeScript
  - Vite
  - Tailwind CSS
  - Express.js
  - SQLite (better-sqlite3)
  - xterm.js
  - react-router-dom
  - framer-motion
  - recharts
  - mermaid
  - monaco-editor
purpose: |
  Rorca is an AI spec orchestration platform for autonomous software development.
  It generates structured specs from plain-English briefs, manages approval workflows,
  and executes user stories via Claude CLI, OpenCode, or Codex with real-time monitoring.
key_modules:
  - "src/panels/ — React UI panels (Specs, Runs, Analytics, Direction, Settings)"
  - "src/components/ — Shared UI components (Sidebar, Shell, RunTerminal, CommandPalette)"
  - "backend/src/routes/ — Express API endpoints (32 route files)"
  - "backend/src/lib/execution-engine.ts — Ralph Loop subprocess orchestration"
  - "backend/src/lib/direction-stack.ts — 5-layer context synthesis"
  - "backend/src/lib/llm-client.ts — LLM provider abstraction"
  - "backend/src/lib/context-router.ts — Dynamic context payload compiler"
  - "backend/src/lib/sse-hub.ts — Centralized pub/sub for WAL events"
  - "backend/src/db/ — SQLite migrations and schema bootstrap"
  - "backend/src/mcp/server.ts — MCP stdio server (5 tools)"
  - "forge/specs/ — Spec JSON files (pending/, approved/)"
constraints:
  - "SQLite is synchronous (better-sqlite3) — no async DB calls"
  - "Backend has no hot-reload — restart required after changes"
  - "Spec id is filename slug, specName is human-readable title"
  - "All spec paths: forge/specs/approved/<slug>.json or forge/specs/pending/<slug>.json"
  - "WAL events table uses 'ts' column, NOT 'created_at'"
  - "Auth middleware is intentionally bypassed globally (local single-user tool)"
deployment_target: "Self-hosted (npm install + npm run dev) or Docker Compose"
integrations:
  - GitHub (OAuth, webhooks, PR creation)
  - Linear (issue sync)
  - Vercel (deploy triggers)
  - Slack (notifications)

=== SPEC BRIEF (L4) ===
Add a health check endpoint
